skipintro.description: Skips the logo movies and the legal notice at startup.
language.description: The game's language. Text and speech of that language must be installed.
hudaspect.description: Auto spreads the HUD across the whole screen, at its sides. A ratio keeps it in a centered box of that shape, such as 16:9 or 21:9. Menus keep their 4:3 layout.
limiter.description: How the frame rate is limited. Choose External when another frame limiter, such as dxwrapper's, is used.
rawinput.description: Uses raw mouse input for the camera; the value also multiplies the mouse sensitivity.
sensfactor.description: Multiplies the game's own mouse sensitivity, which is used when raw mouse input is off.
shadows.description: Renders shadows at three times the original resolution.
distantblur.description: Blurs distant objects, like the PlayStation 2 version. Needs d3d8to9.
bloom.description: Adds a glow around bright areas. Needs d3d8to9.
antialiasing.description: SMAA smooths the edges of each picture. Needs d3d8to9.
consolegamma.description: Deeper contrast and colors, like the Xbox 360 version. Needs d3d8to9.
TCNYC.RawInputMouse.description: The mouse turns the camera on foot and in vehicles; after 5 seconds without mouse movement the game's camera takes over again. Restart the game after changing this option.
TCNYC.InvertMouseY.description: Reverse vertical mouse camera movement relative to the game setting. Applies immediately.
TCNYC.MouseSensitivity.description: How fast the mouse turns the camera. The game's own mouse sensitivity still applies. Changes take effect immediately.
ui.textlanguage.description: Language for all plugins' settings texts. Auto follows the game's language with an English fallback.
ui.settingsoverlayhotkey.description: Windows virtual-key code, pressed together with Ctrl. 121 = F10.
NYC.FOVFactor.description: Gameplay field-of-view multiplier (0.5–2.0). Applies live to settled on-foot and vehicle cameras. Aiming, scripted views, camera transitions, loading and pause remain native.
window.description: Fullscreen, a window at the resolution chosen in the game's settings dialog, or borderless at the monitor's resolution. Restart the game after changing it.
pausefocus.description: Pauses the game while another window is active. Off keeps it running in the background.
confinecursor.description: Keeps the cursor inside the game window while the game is active. It is released when you switch to another window.
video.description: Original shows the startup movies in the 4:3 frame the game used. Fill shows them as large as the screen allows at their own shape. Nothing is cut off or stretched.
fpslimit.description: 30 is the game's original frame rate. 60 runs the game at 60 frames per second with the correct game speed; scenes that need it still run at 30.
updates.description: Once per start, asks fusionfix.io whether a newer version of the fix is out; if FusionFixHub is installed, it opens on the update when you close the game. Off makes no network request.
borders.description: Both keeps the original cinematic picture of cutscenes and title scenes at any aspect ratio, with borders above and below or at the sides. Letterbox keeps only the original borders above and below and shows more at the sides. Pillarbox limits the picture to the 4:3 frame without the borders above and below. Off fills the screen.
bordersanimated.description: The borders slide in and out like the original. Off shows and hides them at once.
